protocol.purpose: Use the California Giraldo-Ospina field subset to diagnose recurrent errors and conditional OISST value without treating sparse field observations as a coastwide prediction block.

population.interpretation: California field-observed subset only; no Oregon, Washington, or Baja generalization

spatial_matching.primary_rule: nearest locked 10-km cell center by haversine distance
spatial_matching.rationale: approximately the half-diagonal of a 10-by-10 km cell

ecological_axes.grazing_log1p: log1p(red urchin density + purple urchin density)
ecological_axes.rock_probability: mean probability of rock in the surveyed site polygon
ecological_axes.kelp_species_contrast: log1p(bull kelp density) minus log1p(giant kelp density)

prediction_diagnostics.risk_rank: within-year percentile, 1 is highest predicted risk

association_model.form: one ecological axis at a time with region and year fixed effects
association_model.axis_scaling: one standard deviation within the analyzed rows
association_model.uncertainty: two-way cell and year cluster-robust standard errors
association_model.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg within each outcome and model family

supported_condition_requires: same directional pattern in at least two of three model families
same directional pattern under the strict 5-km match sensitivity
